notes.title: Arcane Board is out!
notes.content:
Collect magical tiles and deploy them strategically on your Arcane Board in this block sudoku and roguelike deckbuilder. Set up combos and unleash them at the right time—whether offensively, defensively, or to build your power. Master and learn the secrets of the board. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/27023349/a85d9ac7824fb7e9c5766847843e8f1e2fc7dacf.gif[/img]

Get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126090/Arcane_Board/

To celebrate, we are also setting our other games for discount. Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Druidwalker is out NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Druidwalker is out on Steam NOW![/b] It is the next peaceful game produced and published by Coldwild Games!

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231060/Druidwalker/?utm_source=announcement_steam

Step into the role of a druid preparing the forest for winter. Delve into the heart of the mystical forest, explore its paths, and experience the beauty of nature. Druidwalker provides a peaceful roguelike adventure, where challenges offer opportunities for growth and reflection. Rest at the bonfire, rejuvenate, and continue your journey with renewed vigor. The game features traditional instrumental music, creating a peaceful and immersive experience. 

Watch the trailer here: youtu.be/-7Ho_vyXo80
It's a short experience, but a lot of love went into creating this one, so I hope you'll decide to give it a try! :) The game has been created by a multinational team of developers located in Latvia and published by Coldwild Games.

Hope you have a great week ahead, 
Elizabete from Coldwild Games

notes.title: The Early Access release of Stories from the Outbreak is out NOW!
notes.content:
Attention all survivors! The Early Access release of Stories from the Outbreak is finally here!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/a5083be4e65ad4d268b45f3d08df9f6606254b04.gif[/img]

Embark on a turn-based roguelike zombie RPG with a shorter scenario that immerses players in the beginning of the zombie apocalypse. With 11 unique characters, more than 15 enemies, and three expansive maps, the gameplay is challenging, and permadeath adds to the intensity.

Form a team of survivors, traverse the area maps in search of shelter and supplies, fight zombies, and decide the fate of your crew. The game explores the apocalyptic atmosphere through pixel art and characters that speak to each other, showing polarization in views. Will different opinions prevent them from reaching their goals?

The game is available on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Join the fight for survival and make your own story in a world overrun by the undead!

Get the game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968630/Stories_from_the_Outbreak?utm_source=steamnews27march

Thank you for supporting us in our journey. Join us in [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]our discord server[/url] to share your experiences, give us feedback, and connect with others survivors.

Best regards,
Elizabete and the rest of the Coldwild Games team

notes.title: Luna’s Fishing Garden is OUT!

Hello, Coldwild Games players! The day has finally arrived — our next game, Luna’s Fishing Garden is here!

notes.title: Coldwild Games announces a new game, Luna’s Fishing Garden!

notes.title: A new SHMUP in development!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Vladimir here, I wanted to say that Coldwild Games is developing a new shoot-em-up game.

Here's the page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/533050/Lazy_Galaxy_Rebel_Story/

Your character is a robot that executes his old program, trying to defend the civilization that is long gone. The killer feature is that you control a fleet of 3 fighters instead of one, you can swap formations actively in order to avoid / focus fire.

The game will feature rogue-lite systems (you'll pick the permanent bonuses that boost your ship during the walkthrough) and multiple possible weapons that you can pick during the level.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030946/72b6fa20478adaaa1a4f7ededfc7d0802a8cfd2e.png[/img]

You can wishlist the game on the given page and write your comments here if you have any. :)

Best,
Vladimir

notes.title: Frequent Flyer: 1.0.1 patch is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for being patient! Due to your feedback, I was able to implement a few small improvements / bugfixes in the game.

Here's the changelist:
- "Stick"  controls added: can be enabled in settings. After that, the plane in the game will go in the direction your gamepad stick is pointing. 
- Overall improvements of gamepad controls: use A/B to boost/brake. Pause button on Xbox controller is also usable to bring in pause menu to review your missions / tasks.
- Fixed the issue when bottom exp / energy bar showed improperly on widescreen.
- Removed "Tweet" button :) I understand it has probably been annoying to some of you and I did not see much info about the game retweeted anyway.

If you find any issues with the new build - please do not hesitate to let me know and I'll try to fix it asap. I've tested it on all 3 platforms, but I'm just one man developer right now and some bugs could have gone through.

More than anything - thanks for letting me know about the issues, this allows me to improve the game and I sincerely appreciate that.

Cheers,
Vladimir
